Label: Refurbished CPU rack server (Dell PowerEdge R740, 2 x Xeon Gold 6246R, 2019/2020 generation), scaled to 1 kW
Status: variant: refurbished hardware (lever D, T-35); not the case's reference server; the reference house keeps the abstract 1 kW server of config/reference-house.json for scored figures
Description: One 'server' = 1 kW of electric load = 1.96 refurbished dual-socket R740 boxes (Cascade Lake Refresh, 32 cores / 64 threads, 256 GB each). Wall power is a TDP estimate like cpu-server. Wear and failure cost are not in this file: see config/hardware/wear/refurbished-wear.json and docs/research/refurbished-hardware.md.
TranscriptionModel: whisper.cpp base (CPU), own laptop measurement scaled per kWh, times an older-generation efficiency factor

UnitElectricKw.source: estimate: 2 x Xeon Gold 6246R TDP 205 W (Intel ARK SKU 199353 via search snippets of intel.com, wikichip.org and itcreations.com, accessed 2026-11-21, medium) + 256 GB x 0.392 W/GB (Cloud Carbon Footprint memory coefficient, docs/research/computing-price.md §2) = 510.4 W; fans, disks and PSU losses missing, TODO(source): measured wall power

UnitPurchasePriceChf.source: derived: USD 6,770 x 0.8402 CHF/USD (docs/research/ai-services.md); refurbished Dell PowerEdge R740, 2 x Gold 6246R, 256 GB, Newegg marketplace listing https://www.newegg.com/dell-poweredge-rack-mount/p/2NS-0008-71SB5 (search snippet, accessed 2026-11-21, low: listing, seller warranty not shown). Cheaper EU example: used T640 tower 2 x Gold 6248 256 GB EUR 2,910.05 (https://www.ebay.de/itm/187727590188, snippet, low)

HostElectricKw.source: no separate host: the units are complete servers

HostPurchasePriceChf.source: no separate host: the units are complete servers

ServerElectricKw.source: docs/case/challenge.md: rack-server reference (1 kW), used as normalisation

IdleElectricKw.source: derived: same idle/max ratio as config/hardware/cpu-server.json (Cloud Carbon Footprint SPECpower coefficients, medium); not measured on this server; older generations usually idle relatively higher, TODO(source)

HeatRecoveryShare.source: docs/case/challenge.md: 80 percent recoverable into water (assumes liquid cooling; the R740 is air-cooled, retrofit cold plates TODO(source))

LifetimeYears.source: assumption: remaining economic life of 2019/2020 hardware bought in 2026 = typical refurbisher warranty (Bargain Hardware 3-year return-to-base, servermall.com 5-year EU warranty; search snippets accessed 2026-11-21, medium); see docs/research/refurbished-hardware.md §4

OpsChfPerServerYear.source: derived: 1.9594 boxes x CHF 59 per server-month x 12 (data/raw/market/costs.csv cost-ops-smartsolution-server-basic); expected failure cost is NOT included, see config/hardware/wear/refurbished-wear.json

TranscriptionAudioHoursPerServerHour.source: derived: 436 audio h per kWh (config/hardware/cpu-server.json, own measurement) x 0.294 older-generation efficiency factor = SPECpower_ssj2008 overall ssj_ops/W 6,006 (2 x Gold 6226R, Cascade Lake Refresh, spec.org res2022q2) / 20,408 (2 x Platinum 8592+, 2024, spec.org res2024q2); search snippets, configurations not matched, low

WebhostingSitesPerServer.source: TODO(source): no sourced webhosting throughput per kW yet (T-23)

SpotPriceChfPerServerHour.source: derived: 125.4 vCPU per kW (1.9594 boxes x 64 threads) / 32 = 3.919 D32as-equivalents x CHF 0.3056 Azure D32as v5 spot Switzerland North (data/raw/market/compute-prices.csv cp-cpu-azure-d32as-v5-chn-spot, high); assumes buyers pay per vCPU regardless of generation

OnDemandPriceChfPerServerHour.source: derived: 3.919 32-vCPU equivalents x CHF 1.2054 per instance-hour (lowest Swiss on-demand, docs/research/computing-price.md A1: 7.10 / 5.89)

HomeHostPriceChfPerServerHour.source: derived: spot 1.198 x RunPod community/datacentre ratio 0.38 (docs/research/computing-price.md C1 method, GPU ratio applied to CPU: assumption)
